notes.title: DEMO PATCH NOTES #1 – A Special Thanks to Our… Fallen Couriers
notes.content:
We’ve been very busy patching up Panic Delivery, thanks to the invaluable contributions of all the couriers who… well, didn’t make it. 
Your sacrifices (and spectacularly horrible deaths) have helped us track down and squash some nasty bugs—so, in a way, you didn’t die for nothing! ❤️💀

What’s new in this hotfix?
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players would occasionally stretch into eldritch horrors when impaled. We get it, you wanted to be more flexible, but this was too much.
[*] Various UI navigation issues resolved. Now you can panic efficiently!
[*] Added a prompt when leaving the shop without selecting a single item in the loadout tab. Because running into a death trap empty-handed isn’t exactly smart.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Pack Eater enemy sometimes forgot to return eaten packages upon death. Turns out, even monsters can be bad at customer service.
[*] Resolved an audio issue that was playing sounds at the wrong times.* Screams of terror should be appropriately timed, after all.*
[*] Fixed a bug that was preventing voice chat from working under specific circumstances. Now you can properly scream for help—and let your teammates hear your final words.
[/list]
Your feedback (and tragic demises) are crucial to making Panic Delivery even better, so keep those reports coming… and try to stay in one piece! 

See you in the chaos, couriers—assuming you survive. 💀

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/m7cVvP8JBy/]Discord[/url]
Visit our [url=https://panicdelivery.com/]Website[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520160/Panic_Delivery/
